question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password." We'll email you a secure link to choose a new one.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1-2 business days.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes. We ship to over 60 countries. International orders typically arrive within 7-14 business days.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Sign in to your account and open the Orders page to see live tracking for every shipment.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Open Account Settings, choose Billing, and click "Cancel subscription." You keep access until the period ends.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted and processed by a PCI-compliant provider. We never store full card numbers.

question: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
answer: If your order has not shipped yet, you can edit the address from the Orders page. Otherwise contact support.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Email us at help@example.com or use the live chat button at the bottom-right of any page.

question: Do you offer student discounts?
answer: Yes. Verify your student status at checkout to receive 15% off your order.

question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged?
answer: Take a photo and email it to help@example.com within 7 days. We'll send a replacement at no cost.

question: Can I buy a gift card?
answer: Yes. Gift cards are available in $25, $50, and $100 amounts and are delivered by email.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Open Account Settings, edit the email field, and confirm the change from the verification email we send.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes. Our app is available for free on the iOS App Store and Google Play.
